-- Names come from untrusted requests. Only plain file names
-- (no separators, no "..", not empty) may reach the notes directory.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  if name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\"
      return False
  if name.split("..").len() > 1
    return False
  True

-- Returns the note text, or "" when the file is missing or unreadable.
-- A non-empty result only comes from a plain name inside notes.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out == "" or is_plain_name(name)
  if not is_plain_name(name)
    return ""
  var text = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    text = fs.read(name) else ""
  text
